Zwift service status

Source: R/status.R
zwift_status.Rd

Reads Zwift's public status page (https://status.zwift.com). No login needed. Use it to check whether a failed or odd-looking request is down to a Zwift outage.

Usage

zwift_status(
  what = c("status", "components", "unresolved", "incidents", "maintenance"),
  parse = "tbl",
  ttl = 60
)

Arguments

what

Which part of the status page:

  • "status" — one row: overall indicator (none, minor, major, critical) and description (e.g. "All Systems Operational");

  • "components" — one row per service (game servers, login, Companion app, ...) with its status;

  • "unresolved" — incidents still open (often zero rows);

  • "incidents" — the 50 most recent incidents;

  • "maintenance" — upcoming scheduled maintenance.

parse

One of "tbl", "json", "resp".

ttl

Cache time-to-live in seconds. Defaults to 60: status changes quickly.

Value

A tibble (zero rows when there is nothing to report), parsed list, or httr2 response.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
zwift_status()                    # overall indicator
zwift_status("components")        # per-service status
zwift_status("unresolved")        # anything broken right now?
} # }
